## Proposed change
Matter has a custom data type to indicate an expected None value: Nullable
Adjust the generic 'get_matter_attribute_value' helper within the entity model to treat Nullable (instantiated as Nullvalue) as None.

issue_context.title: Unable to control air conditioner added with Matter
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Home Assistant version 2023.7 added support for Matter's Climate device, but it shows the climate entity registered to the Nature Remo nano (https://nature.global/nature-remo/nature-remo-nano/) added with Matter, but it is displayed as "Unavailable" and I can't control it at all.

![スクリーンショット 2023-07-08 20 09 48](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/98800458/905dba0d-7c18-4915-8a01-5021f1cab2d7)

I have tried everything I could do, including restarting the Home Assistant and re-registering the Matter device, but it made no difference at all.

I don't know how to fix this because I don't have any skills, but if this is a bug, I would be very happy if fix it.
Please let me know if there is any other information needed.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.7.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_
